action.objective: Complete broad depth-4 search over all legal moves to find the strongest conversion of the material advantage.
action.rationale: Phase is broad_search and no analyses exist yet; candidate_moves must be [] and search must cover all roots at depth 4 within the 3000-node allowance. White is up a queen for a rook (Q+B+R+3P vs r+k), so the goal is a clean conversion while keeping king safety and avoiding stalemate/perpetual tricks.
